# Live-price fixtures

Trimmed copies of two public model pages fetched on 2026-11-12 with a plain GET (robots.txt allows these paths for `User-agent: *`).

- `cardekho-creta.html`: the JSON-LD block whose `hasVariant` lists variants with ex-showroom prices (12 of 54 kept) and the sentence naming the price city.
- `carwale-creta.html`: the page's embedded `versions` JSON (10 of 38 kept, price fields only). Prices there are labelled "Avg. Ex-Showroom price" (a national average).

The sites change markup and prices; re-fetch before editing a provider.

- `cardekho-creta-mumbai.html`: title and the JSON-LD `hasVariant` of `/hyundai/creta/price-in-mumbai` (on-road prices in Mumbai).
- `carwale-creta-mumbai.html`, `carwale-creta-delhi.html`: title and the embedded `versions` (price fields only) of the CarWale city pages.
- `cardekho-variant-creta-e.html`: the spec-table text of the CarDekho variant page (fuel, transmission, displacement, emission norm).
